subject.title: fix(agents): wake top-level requester when its last parallel child settles

question: Must requester-settle recovery preserve every undelivered child result and deterministically suppress duplicate synthesis across gateway restarts before this PR merges?
rationale: The correct guarantee is an owner-level lifecycle decision: the current patch fixes the observed steady-process stall, but its documented process-local ledger and model-mediated retry suppression deliberately weaken crash and late-success behavior.

options.title: Harden lifecycle state before merge
options.body: Retain the canonical run rows or persist the settle-wave snapshot and delivery marker in lifecycle-owned SQLite, then add restart and late-success regressions before landing.

options.title: Accept the bounded process-local design
options.body: Merge the current implementation with explicit ownership of degraded post-restart findings, possible model-mediated duplicate suppression, and longer restart drains.

recommendation.title: Harden lifecycle state before merge
recommendation.body: Retain the canonical run rows or persist the settle-wave snapshot and delivery marker in lifecycle-owned SQLite, then add restart and late-success regressions before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent major cleanup and terminal-reconciliation refactor owns the lifecycle funnel, restart behavior, and authoritative run-state boundary affected by this choice.
